payload.caption: 3 working points at 3M. Refiner means average downstream seeds within each upstream seed first. Error bars show sample SD across five upstream seeds. For 95/5 through 50/50, refiners use either disjoint B or the same number of training jets sampled from A by event. The original upstream scan, quadratic fits and 100/0 width references are shown. Refiner rejection values are taken directly from their evaluations. The reused results retain their paired upstream means in the data.
